item.title: Gold "supraballs" capture about 90% of the solar spectrum
item.description: At any given moment, 89,000 terawatts of solar power hits the Earth’s surface. While significant advancements have been made in harvesting this power, existing technologies do not capture the full potential of the entire solar spectrum.
